
 Usage: houston ready [OPTIONS]

 Block until Rocket.Chat is serving (polls /api/info).

╭─ Options ──╮
 --name     -n      <str>
 --timeout          <float>  seconds to wait [default: 300.0]
 --json                      NDJSON progress on stdout, then one final JSON envelope
 --help                      Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
